t: What Concrete Mix Performance Database Is All About
title: What Concrete Mix Performance Database Is All About
description: Concrete performance is water-cement ratio: 0.40 w/c makes strong, durable concrete; 0.60 makes weak, porous stuff. 28-day cylinders prove it (4,000 psi standard; 10,000+ high-performance). Curing — keeping it moist — decides half the strength; air entrainment (tiny bubbles) survives freeze-thaw. Supplementary cementitious materials (fly ash, slag) cut CO2 and improve durability. This database is the complete concrete mix: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
